name: logistic_regression_weather
model:
Pipeline(steps=[('preprocess',
                 ColumnTransformer(transformers=[('numeric',
                                                  Pipeline(steps=[('simpleimputer',
                                                                   SimpleImputer(add_indicator=True,
                                                                                 fill_value=0,
                                                                                 strategy='constant')),
                                                                  ('standardscaler',
                                                                   StandardScaler())]),
                                                  ['planned_travel_min',
                                                   'observed_stops',
                                                   'unobserved_sequence_positions',
                                                   'origin_temperature_c',
                                                   'destination_temperature_c',
                                                   'route_temp_max_...
                                                   'route_precip_max_mm',
                                                   'route_precip_24h_mm',
                                                   'route_wind_max_ms',
                                                   'route_wind_max_24h_ms',
                                                   'route_gust_max_ms',
                                                   'route_gust_max_24h_ms',
                                                   'route_snow_depth_cm',
                                                   'snow_on_route_24h']),
                                                 ('categorical',
                                                  OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'),
                                                  ['train_type',
                                                   'starts_at_origin',
                                                   'recorded_route', 'hour',
                                                   'weekday', 'month'])])),
                ('model', LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000))])
